images.caption:
Figure 1:Overview of TFO.(1)The system accepts speech/audio, image, video, and text inputs.(2)Whisper converts audio into transcripts with language, confidence, and timestamp information.(3)The transcript, visual content, and user query are combined into a unified prompt.(4)A frozen VLM processes the prompt while its visual pathway, architecture, and parameters remain unchanged.(5)The model produces a text response, which can optionally be converted to speech using CosyVoice3.
This modular pipeline supports multimodal inputs and text or spoken outputs without modifying the VLM.
